newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wolford to launch ADR programme.
newsitem.headline: Wolford to launch ADR programme.

text.p: Austrian luxury hosiery maker Wolford AG said on Thursday it was planning to launch an American Depository Receipt programme this autumn to prepare for a full U.S. listing, expected in 1997.
"This is a first step towards a real U.S. listing," chief financial officer Karl Michael Millauer told a meeting of analysts.
U.S. investors already controlled as much as 20 percent of Wolford's shares, he added.

The Vorarlberg-based company's shares have risen 60 percent since the start of the year and 480 percent since Wolford went public on Valentine's Day last year, making them the Vienna bourse's top performer. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
